nodes.label: Partial React Logo (Native App Asset)
nodes.description: A cropped/partial view of the React logo rendered in teal/blue (#1a8ca8 approx). Shows the characteristic three overlapping ellipses (atomic orbital rings) of the React logo with the central nucleus circle, but cut off at the bottom-right — only the upper-left portion is visible. Used as a decorative or splash-screen asset in the Expo/React Native app. The color matches the project brand palette.
